steps.en: Boot the Omarchy ISO from USB with Secure Boot off, answer the questions, pick a drive
steps.zh: 关掉安全启动，用 U 盘启动 ISO，答完问题选一块盘

steps.en: Installs encrypted Arch, Hyprland, its desktop shell and default apps from its own repos
steps.zh: 从自家软件源装好加密的 Arch、Hyprland、桌面外壳和默认应用

steps.en: Put your changes in the override files under ~/.config, e.g. rebind a hotkey
steps.zh: 把改动写进 ~/.config 下的覆盖文件，比如改绑一个快捷键

steps.en: Loads its packaged defaults first, then your override files on top
steps.zh: 先加载包里的默认配置，再叠加你的覆盖文件

steps.en: Update through its own updater, not raw pacman
steps.zh: 用它自己的更新命令，而不是直接跑 pacman

steps.en: Snapshots the root, upgrades packages, runs pending migrations, verifies boot files
steps.zh: 给根分区拍快照、升级软件包、跑待执行迁移、校验启动文件

value.en: A themed, working tiling desktop that keeps up with releases without you re-merging dotfiles by hand
value.zh: 拿到一套主题统一、开箱能用的平铺桌面，跟着版本更新也不用自己手动合并配置文件
